title: RNA Extraction from Pichia pastoris
author: Igem Dusseldorf
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8hght3w
materials: centrifugation for 1 min at 10.000 x g

steps.title: Collect Pichia Culture
steps.instruction: Pipette the whole culture of Pichia liquid culture into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Extract RNA using a kit, such as the ZymoResearch YeaStar RNA Kit (Cat.#R1002), following the manufacturer's manual.

steps.title: Measure RNA Concentration and Purity
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the extracted RNA; a A260/280 ratio of ~2.0 indicates pure RNA.

steps.title: Remove DNA Contamination
steps.instruction: Treat samples with DNase to remove DNA contamination and use a Clean and Concentrator Kit, such as the Zymoclean RNA Clean & Concentrator Kit (Cat.# R1013).

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Store the RNA directly at -80° C.
